entry_points.text: Fork uses child-signal notify via central path when MM configured else invalid; vfork adds blocking parent shared; arch clone normalizes flags with pidfd alias; clone3 stages per-ns ids, copies block, validates, delegates; boot idle uses shared memory binding all ids to initial; IO workers share fs, files, handlers, memory, IO grouped untraced; set-tid records pointer and reports tid; unshare forwards flags.

exports.text: Creation validates opts and notify, expands empty-mount, rejects pidfd alias and bad notify, picks tracer event unless untraced, duplicates, traces, resolves id, handles vfork wakeup, returning id or error.

Helpers force shared memory and untraced operation, attach entry with arg and name, mark kernel or user-helper mode; control setup rejects existing state and inits completions plus affinity linkage; stop query reads the flag.

Namespace handling retains the aggregate when allowed else enforces privilege and builds fresh state; pid reserve validates per-level values then publishes; nesting ascends parents; pidfd installs desc and file, needs live linkage unless stale; proxy free drops refs.

Early setup creates caches for sighand with lock and wait init plus signal, files, fs and proxy; thaw wakes all threads of a target; freezable clears exempt then tries freeze; seccomp shares the active filter or does nothing.

hazards.text: Pre-dup pending aborts; dup failure installs nothing and exec-race fs retries; pidfd alias, notify, stack, opts, overridden fs, freezing locked and child use after wake need checks; vfork needs ref and completion.

ABI: CLONE_VM CLONE_FS CLONE_FILES CLONE_SIGHAND CLONE_THREAD CLONE_PARENT CLONE_NEWNS CLONE_NEWUSER CLONE_NEWPID CLONE_PIDFD CLONE_DETACHED CLONE_AUTOREAP CLONE_NNP CLONE_PIDFD_AUTOKILL CLONE_VFORK CLONE_CHILD_SETTID CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID CLONE_CLEAR_SIGHAND, SIG_IGN SIG_DFL SIGKILL SIGSTOP+_NSIG, PIDFD_STALE PIDFD_THREAD PIDFD_AUTOKILL+O_CLOEXEC O_RDWR, ENOMEM EINVAL EAGAIN ESRCH ENOENT EPERM ERESTARTNOINTR; ids from one with reserve, wrap, one-first, per-ns max, PID UTS tasks charged; threads-max 0644 checked, align zero, freezer disabled.
Creation, namespace, pid, freezer and list paths use external helpers for errors, locks, lists, caches, atomics, topology, completions, freezing and sleep checks owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: New tasks start cleared with no memory linkage; memoryless parents yield memoryless threads; VM sharing means joint use else a duplicate; exec follows VM; OOM and futex need VM-sharing; timers start from current limit.

Fs, files, sighand shared or copied, fs refused in exec, clearing forces defaults; threads share signal else fresh state; seccomp shares filter with elevated refs; pid links empty; RCU and RT mutex cleared; reclaim deferred when grouped else immediate; RV clears or not.

Creation rejects bad ns, fs, thread, handler, pidns, userns, pidfd-detached, autoreap, NNP and autokill; leaders join child and global lists, threads join thread set and group stop; parent, notify, terminal, subreaper, confinement and cgroup order follow mode.

Unpriv sharing needs no new class except maybe user with time or VM, else admin and no IPC with shared sem; new pidns checks depth, ancestry, count, starts adding; inherit needs active equals previous; uts shared or cloned; per-ns max and caches private; overlimit ascends clamped; latency and accounting clear.

Clone3 copy enforces versions, sizes, id-list, signals and cgroup with faults; unknown opts, detached, bad signals, shared-plus-cleared and thread-plus-notify rejected with valid stack; unshare checks thread and exclusivity, dups fs and files when needed, needs admin for ns.

Tree walk holds read lock, starts at leader, visits depth-first per visitor; groups use flex object refcount one, translated with faults, sorted ascending; threads-max stages one to max committing only on success; freezing exempts non-freezable, suspend worker and reclaim victims, signal-less or v1 covers all, power only non-kthreads, per-task needs freezable, stopped or traced with saved state.

locks.text: Handler copy, pending and seccomp use parent sighand irq-disabled, seccomp pre-held; fs check uses fs seq exclusive; rlimit uses leader task lock; linkage uses tasklist exclusive; pid checks use id wait lock unless stale; OOM uses global mutex.

Id mutation uses map lock with preload and one retry while attach asserts tasklist exclusive; uts dup holds semaphore and caches created once under mutex; tree walk holds tasklist for read and task lock covers file swap and creation acct; freezer spin covers freezable and rechecks, sched lock covers frozen transition, latency uses dedicated lock.

state_machines.text: Creation validates, quiesces, duplicates, inherits, sets ids and descs, groups and allocs shmem before visibility, infallible after liveness and fatal checks with ordered unwind; ids validate then hide placeholders before publish; namespaces start adding and reaped markers force exhaustion.

Unshare expands deps, warns on overridden fs, validates, stages fs, files, creds, proxy and sem with cleanup, commits sem and shmem, fs and ns switch, file swap locked, cred commit and perf propagation; refrigerator records entry, marks frozen with saved state under sched lock, rechecks against kthread stop, schedules while freezing, restores and reports.

structs.text: Signal holds counts, threads, wait, pending, queues, timers, limits, OOM, sync; fork task spans counters, memory, fs, files, handlers, ids, flags, locks, timing, IO; pid pairs per-level numbers with namespaces plus refcount, lock, wait; ns holds mount, uts, ipc, pid, cgroup, net, time; task and kthread link with exit, park and affinity; sighand holds lock and wait; mm cache sizes base plus cpumask and concurrency aligned auxv-only; groups hold usage, count and ids.
